titles: Du wirst finden, wo du bleiben kannst
Wie man eyn teutsches Mannsbild bey Kräfften hält
Das Wunder von Castel di Sangro
Wer stirbt schon gerne unter Palmen
notes: Portrait, straight-on, a red public bookcase (offener Bücherschrank) outside a glass-fronted building in flat daylight; a mobile phone lies on top among the bird spikes. German throughout with one Italian language course (Conversazioni per tutti). Ten compartments, some books leaning or lying in stacks; spines are legible at full resolution (3456x4608). Series: Guinness Buch der Rekorde is the 1983 volume, labelled by the printed title. Westwind aus Kasachstan stands twice (two copies). Partial: Die Heilerin von Brügge (small type below the author, partly hidden), Das Alphabet des Herzens (only 'DAS ALPH... DES HERZ...' shows between neighbours), Der Turm (only 'URM' visible at the top of a spine behind the stack, second shelf right). Left out: the yellow book with a script title behind Berlin (only 'Ort' shows), the teal graffiti-lettered book by Konechy (title unreadable), the three stacked and turned books on the second and fourth shelves, several spines with only the author readable (Louis de Bernières is kept as Corellis Mandoline because the title reads; Diana Cooper, James B. Dott, Katie Fforde, Konsalik on the far right of shelf 3 excluded), the Cicero magazine and a bible-study booklet in the bottom right compartment (magazine and pamphlet, not books; the draft's 'Der Krieg geht weiter' is the magazine cover line), the Lecker/Rosins Fettkampf magazines lying on shelf 3 left, and the draft's 'Die Wildvögel', which is not on the shelf. Drafted by claude-sonnet-5 (extraction 88), verified by an agent.
